responsibility: Declares target-specific command-line options for the FR30 backend and connects them to internal target masks and option handling. In this port it defines switches controlling the small-address-space code model and omission of the simulator support library from the link line, feeding configuration choices used by instruction selection and driver/link specifications.
same_name_distinction: Is the target option-definition file for the FR30 stem, listing switches like msmall-model and mno-lsim and mapping them to target masks/driver behavior; unlike the sibling .cc, .h, and .md files, it does not implement backend logic, describe RTL instructions, or define the port’s compile-time machine macros.
